live_probe_attestation.execution_environment: Windows x64; PowerShell 7; codex-cli 0.145.0; public app-server stdio; disposable loopback JSON OTLP receiver
live_probe_attestation.repository_safe_command_template: codex -c <otel.log_user_prompt> -c <otel.environment> -c <otel.exporter> -c <otel.trace_exporter> -c <otel.metrics_exporter> app-server --listen stdio; thread/start additionally overrides <history.persistence> and <sqlite_home>
live_probe_attestation.limitation: Counts, identifier shapes, key names, and parent-membership results are retained as sanitized attestation only and cannot be independently regenerated from committed artifacts.

correlation.evidence: A safe replay using only process identifiers and executable paths observed a package-root Codex process with a package-root OS parent process; it did not identify the child role.
correlation.allowed_use: Report the sanitized package-root process-tree relationship as a diagnostic only; it grants no app-server identity, telemetry ownership, or merge authority.

correlation.evidence: The accepted safe process diagnostic did not read command lines or otherwise identify the child role; an earlier command-line-reading attempt was excluded.
correlation.allowed_use: Keep app-server identity and Desktop telemetry ownership unverified.

correlation.evidence: No Desktop-owned session or window was exercised.
thread/start returned a native protocol thread identifier, but the matching OTel span did not carry that native identifier.
correlation.allowed_use: Store the trace as exact OTel metadata with no native Session binding.

correlation.evidence: The turn profile was not executed; native turn and OTel turn fields are unobserved and represented as null in sanitized fixtures.
correlation.allowed_use: Make no turn-to-span support or absence claim.

correlation.evidence: Every observed span carried its source trace identifier.
correlation.allowed_use: Use source-declared OTel trace and span identifiers.

correlation.evidence: Parent span identifier fields were emitted, while two references pointed outside the exported batch.
correlation.allowed_use: Retain source-declared parentage and mark unresolved parents; do not synthesize roots.

correlation.evidence: No concurrent Desktop window or protocol thread profile was executed.
No Desktop restart, protocol restart, or resume profile was executed.

blocked_profiles.blocker: WindowsApps access control denied direct execution of the present Desktop-bundled producer binary.
blocked_profiles.retry_condition: Launch the Desktop-bundled producer through an authorized Desktop-owned path and capture content-disabled OTLP with a disposable loopback receiver.

blocked_profiles.blocker: A safe package-root child/parent process relationship was observed without identifying the child role; no Desktop-owned telemetry execution, App Session, or window was exercised.
blocked_profiles.retry_condition: Execute an authorized Desktop-owned content-disabled run and observe an explicit source-owned process-to-Session relationship without private-state reads.
blocked_profiles.unverified_capability: Desktop package ownership of the producer and App Session/window identity.

blocked_profiles.blocker: The public protocol returned a native thread ID, but the corresponding OTel span did not carry it.
blocked_profiles.retry_condition: Observe the same native thread identifier or an explicit source link on both the public protocol result and OTel evidence in one approved run.
blocked_profiles.unverified_capability: Exact native thread to OTel trace binding.

blocked_profiles.blocker: The turn profile was not executed, so native turn and OTel turn fields remain unobserved rather than observed-absent.
blocked_profiles.retry_condition: Run a separately approved turn with log export disabled, or with a separately authorized and proven non-content log mechanism, and observe the same native turn identifier or explicit source link in public protocol and OTel evidence.
blocked_profiles.unverified_capability: Exact native turn to OTel span binding.

blocked_profiles.blocker: No concurrent Desktop window or protocol thread profile was executed.
blocked_profiles.retry_condition: Execute at least two concurrent approved Desktop-owned windows or protocol threads and prove isolation using only source-native exact identity.

blocked_profiles.blocker: No Desktop restart, app-server restart, reconnect, or resume profile was executed.
blocked_profiles.retry_condition: Execute approved restart, reconnect, and resume cases and observe explicit source-native continuity or an honest unbound result.

blocked_profiles.blocker: Only trace profiles were executed; log and metric profiles were not executed, and documented tool-result log events may carry content even when prompt logging is disabled.
blocked_profiles.retry_condition: Obtain separate content authorization or establish an explicitly non-content log capture mechanism, then run trace, log, and metric exporters through disposable loopback receivers and inventory structures without retaining values.
blocked_profiles.unverified_capability: Complete trace, log, and metric event inventory.

blocked_profiles.blocker: No turn, tool/file, shell, error, retry, permission, or full model/token profile was executed.
blocked_profiles.retry_condition: Execute separately approved simple-turn, multi-turn, tool/file, shell, error, retry, and permission cases with log export disabled, or with a separately authorized and proven non-content log mechanism, and inventory key names and absence states.
blocked_profiles.unverified_capability: Model, token, cache, reasoning token, tool, timing, TTFT, retry, error, permission, ownership, prompt/response, file, and diff fields.

blocked_profiles.blocker: Several profile-codex-app-config and legacy full-routing, Langfuse, and Collector samples enable log export, while pinned rust-v0.145.0 tool-result logs include arguments, output, and error text that may contain content or paths even with prompt logging disabled.
blocked_profiles.retry_condition: A separately approved prerequisite specification must disable generated log export by default or prove an explicitly non-content mechanism, define exact detection and plan tests, and require separate authorization for any content-bearing log profile before production-integration work starts.
blocked_profiles.unverified_capability: Repository-safe generated Codex App routing configuration.

blocked_profiles.blocker: Content-enabled capture was outside the approved authorization.
blocked_profiles.retry_condition: Obtain separate explicit authorization, use disposable loopback and private raw-local storage, then publish only leak-scanned repository-safe structural deltas.
blocked_profiles.unverified_capability: Content-enabled field and event delta plus raw/sanitized boundary behavior.

production_integration_gate.promotion_condition: A separately approved discovery retry and prerequisite configuration contract must first establish Desktop-owned execution with a retained repository-safe replay harness, exact supported configuration and detection, safe log-export policy, source identity and parentage, and exact-or-explicitly-unbound native correlation.
